correctness.rationale: The explicit Lie derivative of P is Q for all real a; symbolic substitution in both Q=0 cone branches verifies the tangency contradiction x/s^2=-2x^2, and the unique equilibrium is the origin. Boundedness gives global continuation, compact omega/alpha sets and bounded differentiable observables. Sign monotonicity and LaSalle yield a<=-1 convergence; two-sided monotonicity and Barbalat plus the unique invariant cone set force both-sector crossings when a>-1. Testing all H(P) proves the conditional signed-measure identity. No numerical finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2015 paper reports a nilpotent-equilibrium reversible attractor where numerical recurrence is difficult to certify. The exact polynomial yields a global parameter half-line free of all nontrivial compact dynamics and an entire opposing-parameter family of compulsory two-sector crossings. Conditioned RMS balance is a falsifiable constraint on every compact recurrent statistical state, stronger than a single unconditional mean, and directly tied to the equilibrium cone. These are nontrivial structural restrictions, not a coefficient substitution or trivial finite check.
